## Summary

Describe the problem and the proposed change.

## Correctness

Explain why sorting order, stability, input preservation, and fallback behavior
remain correct.

## Validation

- [ ] Unit tests pass.
- [ ] New behavior has tests.
- [ ] User-visible changes are documented.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` is updated when appropriate.

## Performance and memory

For native algorithm or heuristic changes, include reproducible before/after
medians, input distributions, environment, and memory tradeoffs.
